context_for_next_testing_agent: IR Thermography PDF generation is fully working in preview environment. The implementation uses: 1) POST /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/generate to start background job, 2) GET /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/status/{job_id} to poll status, 3) GET /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/download/{job_id} to download. PDFs are stored in GridFS to handle large files. The no_images mode is fastest (~10 seconds for 167 items).
